purpose: How a working gold-plating bench decides what a finished piece may lawfully and honestly be called, stamped, pictured and promised: placing each product on the regulated marking-term ladder ('gold flashed', 'gold electroplate', 'heavy gold electroplate', 'vermeil', 'gold filled' and 'rolled gold' as term classes whose current thresholds are verified in the selling jurisdiction), earning each word with dated measurement and accredited-test evidence rather than with confidence, treating nickel release for skin-contact goods as a market-access compliance class, holding durability advertising down to what the coating thickness physically supports, keeping a claim record trail that can answer 'prove it' months later, and freezing and escalating any customer or trade-account request for a claim the evidence does not support.
assumptions: no observed dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
the shop plates with purchased commercial chemistry used per its technical data sheet; this knowledge base reasons about what the finished piece may be called, not about how the bath is run

marking, advertising and skin-contact rules are jurisdiction-specific and change; every threshold named here is a published class structure to be verified against the current rule text in the selling jurisdiction, never a compliance figure to rely on
goods reach buyers through more than one route (own site, marketplaces, wholesale and private label, export), so more than one rule set can bind a single product at the same time

thickness, fineness, porosity, adhesion and nickel-release numbers arrive from the shop's testing and acceptance practice; this knowledge base consumes those numbers and their provenance rather than producing them
the specialist flags, freezes and documents a claim question; final legal sign-off on wording belongs to a human with competence in the selling jurisdiction
exclusions: the discipline that keeps the plating room safe: hazard classes, the cyanide and acid segregation line, storage, labeling, ventilation, personal protective equipment, spill and exposure readiness, and competency records belong to the sibling chemical safety operations knowledge base; nothing here relaxes any of it, and the hard line that cyanide-bearing solutions and acids are never mixed, never stored together and never share a drain holds over every claim deadline in this file

what leaves the shop: rinse waters, spent baths, filters and sludges as regulated waste classes, characterization, manifests, licensed handlers, drag-out reduction and precious-metal reclaim accounting belong to the sibling waste and environmental handling knowledge base; a claim deadline never justifies a disposal shortcut and no sewer or general-refuse routing is described here

how to measure: instrument selection, calibration stacks, coulometric and X-ray fluorescence technique, adhesion and porosity test execution and their acceptance statistics belong to the quality and verification specialist; this knowledge base states what a claim needs from a measurement and how to judge the provenance of the number it is handed

how to plate: bath temperature, pH, gold concentration, current density, time, agitation, rack design and run scheduling belong to the bath chemistry, surface preparation and process execution specialists; those parameters appear here only as the change events that can invalidate an existing claim

medical advice of any kind: nickel allergy, dermatitis, chemical sensitisation and any customer symptom route to the applicable skin-contact regulation class and to a physician or occupational health service; the shop's role is accurate product information and honest records, never diagnosis, reassurance or treatment

legal advice and personalized compliance opinions: this knowledge base names rule classes, the authority that owns them and the verification a shop must perform, and it stops at a documented escalation; it never asserts that a given wording is lawful in a given market and never substitutes for counsel in that market

asserted numeric thresholds as universal fact: the marking ladder values, fineness floors and skin-contact release limits described here are published class structures whose current text, scope and exemptions must be read in the jurisdiction of sale and recorded with the date they were read

trademark, design-right, counterfeit and origin-marking questions, tax and customs classification, and platform seller-policy disputes; each is a separate legal territory that is escalated rather than answered here

competency_questions.question: This batch is gold over a nickel underlayer on steel wire — what exactly am I allowed to call it on the tag, the invoice and the listing?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: TERM_CLASS_LADDER places the product on a term class by base metal, minimum thickness and minimum fineness together, BASE_METAL_PRECONDITION rules out the classes the steel core can never earn, and APPROVED_WORDING_SET converts the earned class into the exact phrases allowed on each surface

competency_questions.question: Which country's rules actually bind this listing when I ship internationally, and how do I know the version of the rule I read is still current?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: JURISDICTION_TERM_MAP names the destinations the channel actually sells into, the authority that owns marking, advertising and skin-contact rules in each, the document consulted and the date it was read, and LISTING_AND_CHANNEL_REVIEW binds each live listing to the most restrictive destination it accepts orders from

competency_questions.question: If I plate a heavy gold layer onto a brass or steel piece, can I call it vermeil?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BASE_METAL_PRECONDITION states that the vermeil class is defined by a sterling silver base and that no plating thickness on a steel or brass core can earn it, and TERM_CLASS_LADDER supplies the class the product can earn instead

competency_questions.question: My in-house screen says the coating makes the heavy-plate class — is that number good enough to print on a label?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ACCREDITED_VS_INHOUSE_EVIDENCE separates process-control screening from claim-grade evidence and states which claims require an accredited measurement, and THICKNESS_CLAIM_BASIS and FINENESS_CLAIM_BASIS state what the number has to be measured on and where

competency_questions.question: Where on the piece does the thickness claim have to hold — the average, or the thinnest spot?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: THICKNESS_CLAIM_BASIS states that a marking class holds at the worst-case point of the significant surface, names the geometry that produces that point on real jewellery, and rejects an averaged number as the basis of a marking word

competency_questions.question: Do I need a nickel-release test before I sell these earrings, and what do I say to a customer who tells me they react to jewellery?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: NICKEL_RELEASE_COMPLIANCE_CLASS names the skin-contact release class, the wear-and-corrosion simulation that applies to coated articles, and the accredited certificate a market may require, DISCLOSURE_PACKAGE states what the buyer is told about the metal stack, and COMPLAINT_AND_REMEDY_HANDLING routes any symptom to professional care with no clinical opinion offered

competency_questions.question: How long am I allowed to say the plating will last?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: DURABILITY_CLAIM_DISCIPLINE ties any wear statement to the measured thickness class, the wear location and a qualitative band, forbids lifetime and never-tarnish language, and THICKNESS_CLAIM_BASIS supplies the measured number the band is allowed to rest on

competency_questions.question: What am I allowed to stamp into the metal itself, and what must accompany a quality mark?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: STAMP_AND_HALLMARK_DISCIPLINE separates a quality mark from a fineness mark that belongs to solid material, states the maker or trademark identification that accompanies a quality mark in several jurisdictions as a rule class to verify, and forbids any stamp the coating class has not earned

competency_questions.question: A wholesale account wants their page to say '18k gold' and 'lifetime guarantee' on my plated pieces — what do I actually do?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: TRADE_ACCOUNT_CLAIM_REQUESTS gives the refusal-with-alternative move and the contractual wording constraint, NEVER_SOLID_GOLD_RULE states the line that no account can move, and NONCOMPLIANT_CLAIM_ESCALATION gives the freeze, document and human-sign-off path

competency_questions.question: A customer brings in their own marked ring for gold plating — what may I say about it afterwards and what must I write down?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: REPLATE_AND_SECONDHAND_LIMITS states that an existing mark is never re-cut, extended or implied to describe the new coating, requires written disclosure that the piece has been re-plated, and DISCLOSURE_PACKAGE supplies the customer-facing record that travels with the piece

competency_questions.question: If a regulator, a marketplace or an angry buyer asks me to prove the tag six months from now, what do I need to be able to put on the table?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CLAIM_EVIDENCE_TRAIL names the dated records, certificates, retained samples and lot linkage that reconstruct the claim, and PRODUCT_CLAIM_DOSSIER states the per-product record the trail hangs on

competency_questions.question: I changed gold solution supplier and trimmed the plating time to save cost — what has to change before the next order ships?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PROCESS_CHANGE_RECLASSIFICATION lists the change events that invalidate an existing claim class, APPROVED_WORDING_SET is re-derived from the new evidence, and CLAIM_RELEASE_GATE blocks release until the re-test and re-wording are complete

competency_questions.question: What has to be true before a finished batch may be photographed, listed and shipped?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CLAIM_RELEASE_GATE states the complete-dossier, approved-wording, dated-evidence and closed-escalation conditions, LISTING_AND_CHANNEL_REVIEW proves the live channel text matches the approved wording, and IMPLIED_CLAIM_CONTROL proves the imagery and price framing carry no claim the words are not allowed to make

glossary.definition: The published class structure that ties each permitted description of a gold-surfaced article to a combination of base metal, minimum coating thickness and minimum gold fineness; the United States Federal Trade Commission jewellery guidance and the ISO 27874 coating classes are the two class structures most often cited on a plating bench, and the current text of whichever applies in the market of sale is what actually governs.

The term class for an electrodeposited gold surface that meets the published minimum thickness for the class (the commonly cited class boundary is 0.175 micrometres, about seven millionths of an inch) at a gold fineness at or above the published floor (commonly cited as ten karat); below that thickness the honest words are the flash or wash classes, and the current threshold must be verified in the selling jurisdiction.

The term class for a substantially thicker electrodeposit, commonly cited at a 2.5 micrometre (one hundred millionths of an inch) class boundary; on a bench this is the class that separates a decorative surface from a coating that can survive ring and bracelet wear, and it is also the class that costs real gold to reach.

A term class defined by what is underneath as much as by the gold: a sterling silver base carrying a gold coating at or above the heavy-plate thickness class. A steel-, brass- or zinc-cored piece cannot become vermeil at any plating thickness, which makes this the clearest example of a base-metal precondition on the bench.

glossary.term: gold filled and rolled gold plate
glossary.definition: Term classes for mechanically clad stock, where a gold alloy layer is bonded and worked onto a base metal to a stated weight fraction of the finished article (a one-twentieth by weight class is the commonly cited example); these are mill products, not electroplating outcomes, so a plating shop cannot produce goods entitled to these words no matter how thick the deposit.

The honest term classes for a gold surface below the electroplate thickness class: cosmetically gold, measured in fractions of a micrometre, and expected to wear through the areas that touch skin quickly; used deliberately, these words protect a shop, because they set the buyer's expectation at what the coating can actually do.

The thinnest location on the surface a marking claim covers — typically the inside of a ring shank, a recess, the back of a pendant bail or a shielded spot on a wire form — because deposition follows current distribution and recesses starve; a marking class is judged there rather than on a flat, well-exposed face or on an average across the piece.

The rate at which nickel migrates from an article into prolonged skin contact, treated as a market-access compliance class rather than a material specification; the standard class pairs a release measurement method (EN 1811) with a wear-and-corrosion simulation for coated articles (EN 12472), because a coating that hides nickel when new may not hide it after wear, and the current limits, scope and exemptions must be read in the market of sale.

A measurement performed by a laboratory holding recognised accreditation for the method, producing a certificate that names the article, the method, the date and the result; it is the evidence class that anchors a legal claim, in contrast with an in-house screen, which is fast and cheap and exists to catch process drift but cannot support a marking or market-access claim.

The per-product record that carries the substrate and underlayer stack, the deposit system, the measured thickness and fineness with their measurement provenance and dates, any accredited certificates, the earned term class, the approved wording for every surface and channel, and the effective dates and change history that say which batches the claim covers.

nodes.definition: Establish that every word attached to a plated piece is a regulated claim and that claim review is a gate the batch passes through, not a marketing task that happens after the parts are boxed. The claim surface is wider than most benches assume: the swing tag, the stamp in the metal, the invoice line, the marketplace title and attribute fields, the product photograph, the care card, the wholesale line sheet and the answer given over the counter are all statements about the same article, and any one of them can be the one a buyer or an authority reads. The mandate names an owner for the claim decision, states that the owner may stop a shipment, and fixes the order of operations: evidence first, term class second, wording third, imagery and channel copy last. It also fixes what this bench will never trade away — a plated article is never described, priced or implied as solid gold, wear expectations are disclosed before the sale rather than argued after it, and compliance beats the ship date every time the two meet.

included: the full inventory of claim surfaces a plated article carries
the named owner of the claim decision and their authority to hold a batch
the evidence-before-wording order of operations
the non-negotiable honesty lines that no commercial pressure moves
excluded: the plating process itself and its safety and waste obligations, which belong to the sibling knowledge bases
pricing strategy and margin decisions
giving the legal opinion that a specific wording is lawful in a specific market

pros.claim: Treating the claim as a gate stops the common failure where the tag is written by whoever is packing the order
pros.example: a rush of festival stock is held at the bench because nobody can say which of two thickness targets the run was actually plated to

pros.claim: Naming every claim surface catches the ones nobody thinks of as claims
pros.example: the marketplace attribute field that says 'material: gold' is caught in the same review as the printed tag

cons.claim: A gate placed at the end of the flow feels like an obstacle and invites quiet bypass on busy days
cons.example: a wholesale reorder ships against last season's approved wording because nobody wanted to reopen the file

cons.claim: A mandate that names an owner but gives no evidence route just relocates the guesswork
cons.example: the owner is asked to approve 'gold plated' for a run with no thickness record and has nothing to decide on

failure_modes: writing the tag from what the piece looks like rather than from what was measured
reviewing the tag but never the photographs, the attribute fields or the counter conversation
letting an unresolved claim question ride along with a shipment on the promise of fixing it later
treating the mandate as a document rather than as a stop authority somebody actually exercises
acceptance_tests: a named person can hold a shipment on a claim question and has done so at least once without the decision being reversed informally
the claim-surface inventory lists tag, stamp, invoice, listing text, attribute fields, imagery, care card and wholesale sheet for the product being released
no product in the catalogue carries a marking word that cannot be traced to a dated measurement
revisit_triggers: a new sales surface appears, such as a marketplace, a live-selling channel or a reseller catalogue
a claim question is discovered after shipment rather than at the gate
the person holding the claim decision changes

base.update_signal: a claim reaches a buyer without passing the gate, or a new selling surface is added that the claim-surface inventory does not list

nodes.definition: Build and maintain a dated register of which markets the shop's goods actually reach and which rule classes bind them there. A bench that sells from a single town still ships internationally the moment it opens a marketplace storefront, and marking rules, advertising-honesty rules, skin-contact restriction rules and consumer-guarantee rules are owned by different authorities and change on their own schedules. The register holds, per destination, the rule class (marking and description, advertising substantiation, restricted substances and skin contact, hallmarking or assay obligations, consumer remedy rights), the authority that owns it, the document or rule text actually consulted, the date it was read, and the next date it must be re-read. It records unknowns honestly: where the shop has not verified a destination's rule, the register says so and the destination stays closed rather than being assumed permissive. This node produces rule classes and verification dates, never a compliance opinion; where a destination's rule is unclear or high-stakes, the answer is counsel in that market.

included: the destination list derived from the channels actually enabled
rule classes with their owning authority and the document consulted
the read date and the re-read date for every entry
explicit unknown entries that close a destination until verified
excluded: reproducing rule text as fact or asserting current numeric thresholds
customs, tax and origin-marking classification
advising that a particular wording is lawful in a particular market, which is a decision for counsel there

pros.claim: A dated register makes staleness visible instead of letting a rule reading age silently into a liability
pros.example: a skin-contact entry read two years ago shows its re-read date has passed before the season's earring line is listed

pros.claim: Listing destinations from the channels actually enabled catches the export nobody planned for
pros.example: the shop discovers its marketplace storefront has been accepting orders from a market whose marking rules it has never read

cons.claim: Maintaining the register costs recurring attention that a one-person bench resents until something goes wrong
cons.example: four destinations with three rule classes each become twelve entries to re-read on a cadence

cons.claim: A register of rule classes can create false comfort that the shop understands the rules it has only named
cons.example: an entry naming a skin-contact restriction is mistaken for confirmation that the product complies with it

failure_modes: assuming the home market's rules travel with the parcel
reading a summary article instead of the authority's own rule text and recording the article as the source
leaving an unverified destination open on the assumption it is probably fine
recording the rule without recording the date, so nobody can tell whether it is current
acceptance_tests: every destination the enabled channels accept orders from has an entry or is switched off
each entry names the authority, the document consulted, the date read and the next re-read date
unverified destinations are marked unknown and are closed rather than assumed permissive
revisit_triggers: a new channel, marketplace or export destination is enabled
an entry passes its re-read date
an authority announces a change to a marking, advertising or restricted-substance rule
an escalation returns a legal answer that contradicts an entry

base.update_signal: an authority publishes a change, a new destination is opened, or a re-read date passes without the entry being refreshed

nodes.definition: Hold the marking-term ladder as a class structure rather than as a list of words, because every rung is defined by a combination of conditions and a shop that remembers only the thickness number will eventually misuse a term. The published structures a plating bench meets most often set out, in ascending order: a flash or wash class for a gold surface below the electroplate thickness boundary; an electroplate class at or above a stated minimum thickness (0.175 micrometres, seven millionths of an inch, is the commonly cited boundary) and at or above a stated minimum fineness (ten karat is the commonly cited floor); a heavy electroplate class at a substantially greater thickness (2.5 micrometres, one hundred millionths of an inch, is the commonly cited boundary); a vermeil class that additionally requires a sterling silver base; and clad-stock classes, gold filled and rolled gold plate, defined by a bonded worked layer at a weight fraction of the article and therefore unreachable by any plating process. ISO 27874 defines coating classes for jewellery with thickness grades and fineness in parallel. The ladder is used as a hypothesis to be tested against measurement, and its current thresholds, scope and exemptions are verified in the market of sale before any word is printed.

included: the ascending class structure and the conditions that define each rung
the fact that each rung is a conjunction of base metal, thickness and fineness rather than a single number
the classes that plating can never reach because they describe clad mill stock
the requirement to verify current thresholds in the market of sale
excluded: asserting a threshold as current law anywhere
measurement technique, which belongs to the verification specialist
hallmarking and assay-office obligations beyond naming them as a rule class to verify

pros.claim: Treating each rung as a conjunction prevents the most common marking error, which is reaching a thickness and forgetting the fineness or the base metal
pros.example: a run that reaches the heavy-plate thickness in a low-fineness bright gold still cannot use the electroplate family of words until the fineness is checked

pros.claim: The ladder converts a marketing argument into an arithmetic question with a measurable answer
pros.example: the debate over whether to say 'gold plated' or 'gold flashed' ends when the worst-case thickness number is read out

cons.claim: The ladder as a general class structure cannot tell a shop what any specific market currently requires, so it must always be paired with a verification step
cons.example: a shop that memorised one market's boundary applies it to an export order governed by a different structure

cons.claim: Class boundaries create a cliff edge where a small process saving destroys a word the whole product page depends on
cons.example: trimming plating time to save gold drops the coating just under the heavy-plate boundary and invalidates the listing

failure_modes: using a term because competitors use it rather than because the product meets its class conditions
applying a remembered threshold to a market whose rule text was never read
quoting the class boundary as though it were the achieved thickness
treating gold filled or rolled gold as a thicker version of plating rather than as a different product class
acceptance_tests: for the product in question, the shop can state the rung, the three conditions that rung requires and the evidence held for each
any rung claimed is traceable to a rule text read in the market of sale with a recorded date
the clad-stock classes are marked unreachable in the shop's own product catalogue
revisit_triggers: a rule text in the jurisdiction register is updated
a new product introduces a base metal or a deposit system the ladder has not been applied to
a measurement lands within measurement uncertainty of a class boundary

base.update_signal: a jurisdiction register entry changes a class boundary, or a product is introduced whose base metal or deposit does not fit an existing rung

nodes.definition: Check what is underneath before any term is entertained, because several rungs of the ladder are gated by the base metal and no amount of gold changes the answer. The vermeil class requires a sterling silver base; a steel-cored wire ring, a brass casting or a zinc-alloy component cannot become vermeil at any thickness, and calling it so is a false description rather than an exaggeration. The clad classes describe a mechanically bonded worked layer and are unreachable by deposition. Underlayers matter too: a nickel barrier under the gold is invisible to the buyer but decides whether a skin-contact compliance class applies, and a copper strike or a silver underlayer changes both the tarnish behaviour the durability wording may describe and the base-metal statement the disclosure has to make. On a bench that plates mixed substrates the practical discipline is that the substrate and underlayer stack is recorded at intake, travels with the job, and is the first thing the claim owner reads, because a substrate substitution by a casting supplier can silently invalidate a whole product line's wording.

included: substrate identity as a precondition for specific term classes
the underlayer stack as a compliance-relevant and disclosure-relevant fact
recording the stack at intake so it travels with the job
supplier substitution as an invalidation event
excluded: substrate preparation and adhesion practice, which belong to the surface preparation specialist
alloy metallurgy and casting quality
deciding the skin-contact test itself, which is the nickel release compliance class

pros.claim: A substrate check is the cheapest possible claim control because it is a fact known before any gold is spent
pros.example: a job ticket that names brass rules out the vermeil wording before the piece reaches the tank

pros.claim: Recording the underlayer stack answers later questions that the finished surface cannot
pros.example: months after a sale the shop can say whether a nickel barrier is present under the gold of a specific batch

cons.claim: Bought-in components arrive with vague or optimistic material descriptions and verifying them costs time or analysis
cons.example: a findings supplier's 'silver-tone' clasp turns out not to be sterling when the vermeil wording depended on it

cons.claim: A mixed-material assembly can be honestly describable only in awkward compound language that marketing resists
cons.example: a sterling body with base-metal ear wires cannot carry one clean word for the whole article

failure_modes: assuming a component is sterling because it looks and sounds like it
applying a term earned by the main body to an assembly containing base-metal parts
losing the underlayer record so a later skin-contact question cannot be answered
accepting a substrate substitution from a supplier without re-checking the affected wording
acceptance_tests: the job record names the substrate and every underlayer for the batch being released
for any term class with a base-metal condition, the substrate evidence is recorded rather than assumed
assemblies with mixed materials are described component by component or dropped to a term all parts can carry
revisit_triggers: a component supplier changes or substitutes material
a new assembly combines materials the existing wording did not anticipate
an incoming inspection contradicts a supplier's material statement

base.update_signal: a supplier substitutes a substrate or component material, or an incoming check contradicts a declared material

nodes.definition: Decide what a thickness number must be before a marking word may rest on it. Three properties matter and each one is routinely fudged. The first is location: a marking class is judged at the worst-case point of the surface the claim covers, which on real jewellery means the inside of a ring shank, the recess of a textured face, the shielded side of a wire form or the back of a bail, because deposition follows current distribution and recesses starve; an average across the piece, or a reading taken on the brightest exposed face, is not the number the word rests on. The second is representativeness: the measured piece must come from the batch and the process the claim covers, not from a hand-finished sample plated at leisure. The third is provenance: the number carries the method, the instrument, the operator, the date and the calibration state, because a number without provenance cannot be defended and cannot be reproduced. Curved thin sections and very thin deposits are exactly where instrument error is largest, so a reading near a class boundary is a reason to obtain a better measurement rather than to round upward.

included: the worst-case point rule and the geometry that produces it
batch representativeness of the measured article
the provenance fields a claim-grade number carries
the near-boundary rule that uncertainty is resolved downward or by better measurement
excluded: measurement technique, instrument choice and calibration practice, which belong to the verification specialist
process changes that raise or lower thickness, which belong to the process specialists
the fineness question, which is a separate condition of the same class

pros.claim: Judging at the worst-case point makes the claim survive the one test a buyer actually applies, which is wearing the piece
pros.example: a ring whose inner shank reads well below its outer face is marked at the shank number and does not wear through to a complaint

pros.claim: Provenance fields turn a number into evidence that can be produced later
pros.example: a challenged tag is answered with the reading, the method, the date and the batch it came from

cons.claim: Measuring the worst-case point is harder than measuring a flat face and sometimes requires destructive sectioning of a saleable piece
cons.example: confirming the inside of a narrow shank costs a finished ring from the run

cons.claim: Honouring the worst-case rule can drop a whole run one rung and destroy the pricing the run was quoted at
cons.example: a batch sold as heavy plate is re-marked to the lower class because the recesses fall short

failure_modes: reading the brightest, most exposed face and calling it the coating thickness
measuring a sample plated differently from the production run
rounding a near-boundary reading upward to keep the desired word
recording a number with no method, date or instrument state attached
acceptance_tests: the recorded number identifies the location it was taken at and that location is the worst case for the claim area
the measured article is traceable to the batch and process the claim covers
readings within measurement uncertainty of a class boundary are resolved downward or re-measured by a better method
revisit_triggers: the part geometry or racking changes so the starved area moves
a process change alters deposition distribution
a measurement lands near a class boundary
a complaint suggests wear-through in an area that was never measured

base.update_signal: a geometry, racking or process change moves the starved area, or a repeat measurement contradicts the recorded worst-case reading

nodes.definition: Establish what the gold in the deposit actually is before any karat or purity word is used, because fineness is a separate condition from thickness and is far more often asserted than measured. Published deposit classes distinguish high-purity and alloyed electrodeposits (the ASTM B488 type structure separates classes at 99.9, 99.7 and 99.0 weight per cent gold), and the marking ladder additionally imposes a minimum fineness floor for the electroplate family of words, commonly cited at ten karat. A shop plating a cobalt- or nickel-hardened bright gold or a coloured alloy bath cannot infer the deposit's fineness from the bath's name or from the colour it produces; the deposit's composition is what the supplier's technical data sheet describes and what an assay on an adequately thick witness measures, since thin coatings under-read on surface assay methods. The honest positions are therefore narrow: state the fineness class the deposit is verified to hold, state the colour by an appearance class rather than as a karat claim, and never let a colour name migrate into a purity claim on the tag.

included: fineness as a condition of the marking class distinct from thickness
the supplier technical data sheet and an assay on an adequate witness as the two legitimate sources
why thin coatings under-read on surface assay and what to do about it
the line between a colour appearance class and a karat claim
excluded: bath composition, additives and how to move deposit alloy content, which belong to the bath chemistry specialist
assay technique and instrument calibration, which belong to the verification specialist
the appearance and colour matching decision itself

pros.claim: Separating fineness from thickness closes the most persuasive marking shortcut on a bench, which is assuming a thick deposit is a pure one
pros.example: a hardened bright gold deposit is thick enough for the heavy class but its alloy content still has to be evidenced before the family of words is used

pros.claim: Using a colour appearance class keeps an honest vocabulary for a real customer question
pros.example: a warm yellow finish is described by its colour class and its verified deposit class instead of being called eighteen karat

cons.claim: Assay of a real coating needs a witness thick enough to measure, which consumes gold and time on a small run
cons.example: a coupon plated alongside a short job purely so the deposit can be assayed

cons.claim: Technical data sheets describe a deposit obtained under the supplier's conditions, so a shop running a drifted bath cannot treat the sheet as its own result
cons.example: a bath running outside its stated operating window yields a deposit the sheet no longer describes

failure_modes: reading the karat number off the bath's trade name
inferring fineness from the deposit's colour
assaying a thin coating directly and accepting the under-read number
using a karat word for a plated surface in a way that implies solid material
acceptance_tests: the fineness position stated for the product names its source, either the technical data sheet for the chemistry in use or an assay on an adequate witness, with a date
any karat word appearing on any surface is tied to that recorded fineness evidence and is qualified as a coating
colour descriptions are appearance classes and appear nowhere as purity claims
revisit_triggers: the gold chemistry or supplier changes
the bath drifts outside the operating window the technical data sheet describes
an assay result disagrees with the assumed deposit class

base.update_signal: the gold chemistry changes, the bath drifts outside its stated operating window, or an assay contradicts the assumed deposit class

nodes.definition: Treat nickel release from skin-contact goods as a market-access compliance class that is decided before the product is offered, not as an allergy conversation held after a complaint. The mechanism is specific to plated work: a nickel underlayer is standard practice under gold because it levels, brightens and blocks base-metal diffusion, and a thin or porous gold layer over it does not necessarily stop nickel reaching skin, which is why the standard class pairs a release measurement (EN 1811) with a wear-and-corrosion simulation for coated articles (EN 12472) that ages the article before the release is measured. The published class distinguishes articles in prolonged skin contact from post-assemblies inserted into pierced parts, with the commonly cited limits being 0.5 and 0.2 micrograms per square centimetre per week respectively; the current limits, the scope of what counts as prolonged contact and the exemptions must be read in the market of sale. The bench decisions that follow are practical: either evidence the article with an accredited certificate retained per product line, or specify a nickel-free underlayer route, or do not offer the article into that market. Any customer symptom is routed to professional care, never diagnosed at the counter.

included: nickel release as a market-access class for skin-contact articles
why coated articles need the wear-and-corrosion simulation before release measurement
the accredited certificate retained per product line as the evidence artifact
the three honest bench responses: certify, redesign the underlayer route, or do not offer
excluded: diagnosing, advising on or reassuring about any individual's skin reaction, which routes to a physician
nickel handling and exposure controls in the plating room, which belong to the chemical safety knowledge base
the disposal of nickel-bearing solutions, which belongs to the waste knowledge base

pros.claim: Deciding the compliance route before launch prevents a product line becoming unsellable in a market after stock is made
pros.example: an earring line is specified with a nickel-free underlayer route before the first production run rather than after a marketplace demands evidence

pros.claim: The wear-and-corrosion simulation reflects how a plated article actually fails, so evidencing it is honest rather than ceremonial
pros.example: a thin gold layer that passes when new is aged first, which is the condition the buyer will experience

cons.claim: Accredited certification carries fees and lead time that a small bench feels acutely, and it applies per product and process rather than once for the shop
cons.example: a certificate obtained for one earring style does not cover a new style plated on a different underlayer route

cons.claim: A certificate proves the tested article, not every article the shop will ever make, so it must be paired with process discipline to stay meaningful
cons.example: a process change after certification leaves the certificate describing an article the shop no longer produces

failure_modes: assuming a gold coating makes a nickel-containing article compliant by itself
testing an unworn article and ignoring the wear-and-corrosion simulation the coated-article route requires
describing goods as hypoallergenic or nickel free without evidence for the specific stack
answering a customer's reaction with reassurance or a clinical opinion instead of product facts and a referral
acceptance_tests: for every skin-contact product offered into a market with a release restriction, the shop holds either an accredited certificate for that stack or a documented decision not to offer it there
the tested article is traceable to the production process and underlayer route still in use
no marketing surface carries a hypoallergenic or nickel-free phrase that the held evidence does not support
the counter response to a reported reaction is a product-fact statement plus a referral, with the interaction recorded
revisit_triggers: the underlayer route, gold thickness or substrate changes
a new market with a skin-contact restriction is opened
a customer reports a reaction to a specific product line
the certificate ages past the refresh point the shop has set

base.update_signal: the underlayer route or coating thickness changes, a new restricted market is opened, or a reaction report links to a product line

nodes.definition: Keep two evidence grades apart and never let the cheaper one do the expensive one's job. In-house screening exists to catch process drift: a bend or wrap check, a tape pull, a ferroxyl porosity screen on an iron-cored part, an artificial-sweat soak, a colour comparison against a retained master panel and a coulometric or handheld thickness reading are fast, repeatable and run on every batch, and they are the shop's early warning system. Claim-grade evidence is different in kind: it is produced by a laboratory accredited for the method, names the article, method, date and result, and is what anchors a marking word, a fineness statement or a market-access position. The practical rule that follows is that accredited testing is commissioned once per product and per process state rather than per batch, while in-house screening runs continuously and its job is to prove that the batch still resembles the article the certificate describes. A shop that blurs the two either pays for testing it does not need or prints words its evidence cannot carry.

included: the functional split between drift detection and claim anchoring
which claims require accredited evidence and which are satisfied by internal control
the once-per-product-and-process-state cadence for send-out testing
the role of in-house screens in proving continued resemblance to the certified article
excluded: how to run each screen and how to interpret its result, which belongs to the verification specialist
laboratory selection commercial terms
the marking decision itself, which belongs to the wording nodes

pros.claim: The split makes a small shop's compliance affordable because the expensive evidence is bought once per product state, not per batch
pros.example: one accredited thickness and release position anchors a season while cheap screens run on every batch

pros.claim: Continuous screening gives the certificate its ongoing meaning by detecting the drift that would make it obsolete
pros.example: a colour drift against the retained master panel triggers a bath check before the batch is released under a certified claim

cons.claim: In-house screens are comparative and can be trusted too far by an operator who has watched them agree with the laboratory once
cons.example: a handheld reading on a curved wire section is treated as a claim-grade number because it matched a certificate on a flat coupon

cons.claim: Waiting for accredited results imposes lead time that collides with seasonal launch dates
cons.example: a launch date arrives before the certificate does and the product can only be offered under a lower claim

failure_modes: printing a marking word on the strength of an in-house screen alone
skipping in-house screening because an accredited certificate exists
sending an unrepresentative hand-finished sample for accredited testing
treating a certificate as valid after the process it describes has changed
acceptance_tests: every marking, fineness and market-access claim names the evidence grade it rests on
the article sent for accredited testing is drawn from normal production and its lot is recorded
in-house screen results for released batches exist and are within the tolerance that keeps them consistent with the certified article
revisit_triggers: a screen result diverges from the certified position
the process or chemistry changes
a laboratory or method change alters what the certificate covers

base.update_signal: an in-house screen diverges from the certified position, or a process change makes the certified article unrepresentative of production

nodes.definition: Assemble one record per product that holds everything a claim depends on, so the claim decision is made once, deliberately, and can be re-made when something changes. The dossier carries the article description and the substrate and underlayer stack; the deposit system and the chemistry in use; the measured worst-case thickness with its provenance and date; the fineness position with its source; any accredited certificates including skin-contact release where applicable; the term class the evidence earns; the approved wording for each surface and channel; the durability band and care text; the effective date and the batches the claim covers; and the change history that records why a claim was raised, lowered or withdrawn. Its value is that it converts a scattered set of measurements and opinions into one auditable object with an owner, and its discipline is that a product with an incomplete dossier is not released rather than released on the assumption that the missing piece is probably fine.

included: the fields that make a claim reconstructable
the earned term class and the approved wording it licenses
effective dates and the batch coverage of a claim
the change history explaining every raise, drop or withdrawal
excluded: the production traveller and process logs themselves, which belong to the process specialists
pricing, cost and margin records
the legal opinion on whether the wording is lawful in a given market

pros.claim: One object with an owner replaces a search through invoices, photographs and memory when a claim is challenged
pros.example: a marketplace evidence request is answered from a single file rather than from three people's recollections

pros.claim: The change history makes claim drift visible, which is the failure that quietly accumulates over seasons
pros.example: the record shows a thickness target was trimmed twice while the listing wording never moved

cons.claim: Dossier upkeep is real recurring work and is the first thing dropped when the bench is busy
cons.example: three new variants ship under an old product's dossier because nobody opened new ones

cons.claim: A dossier can look complete while resting on a stale certificate or an undated measurement
cons.example: every field is filled but the thickness entry has no date and no method

failure_modes: one dossier stretched across variants that are plated differently
leaving the earned class as an intention rather than as a conclusion supported by the fields above it
no effective date, so nobody can say which batches a claim covers
changes made to the product without a corresponding dossier entry
acceptance_tests: each released product has a dossier whose fields are all either filled with dated evidence or explicitly marked unknown
the earned term class in the dossier follows from the recorded substrate, thickness and fineness evidence
every wording change and every claim raise or drop appears in the change history with a reason and a date
revisit_triggers: a variant is introduced that the existing dossier does not describe
any evidence field is superseded by a newer measurement or certificate
an effective date passes without the covered batches being updated

base.update_signal: a new variant appears, an evidence field is superseded, or a product change is made with no dossier entry

nodes.definition: Hold the one line that no measurement, deadline or account can move: a plated article is never described, stamped, priced or implied to be solid gold. The line is broken far more often by omission and framing than by an outright false sentence. Dropping the qualifier so a title reads simply as gold, using a karat number with no coating qualifier, pricing a piece in the range buyers associate with solid material without a plain description, presenting a plated piece as an investment or as an heirloom that will pass down generations, photographing it beside solid stock in a way that invites the comparison, or answering a direct question at the counter with a shrug all put the same false impression in a buyer's head. The rule is enforced positively rather than by prohibition alone: the qualifying words travel with the noun in every position where the noun appears, including truncated titles and attribute fields, and any wording that survives only because the buyer did not read carefully is rewritten.

included: the omission and framing routes to a false solid-gold impression
the positive rule that the qualifier travels with the noun everywhere
price framing and investment or heirloom positioning as claims
the counter conversation as a claim surface
excluded: the legal test for deception in any particular market, which is a matter for counsel there
the term class the product may honestly use, which the ladder decides
the durability band, which is a separate wording control

pros.claim: A single unconditional line removes the argument entirely, which is what makes it survivable under commercial pressure
pros.example: a reseller's request to drop the qualifier from a title is refused without a negotiation about how much it matters

pros.claim: Enforcing the qualifier positionally catches the truncation failures that a prohibition would miss
pros.example: a marketplace title truncated for mobile display still shows the coating qualifier because it sits next to the noun

cons.claim: Explicit qualifiers cost conversion against competitors whose listings are vaguer
cons.example: a clearly qualified listing sits beside an unqualified one at a similar price and looks like the lesser product

cons.claim: The line is easy to state and hard to police across surfaces the shop does not control
cons.example: a reseller's own page rewrites the description after the goods leave the bench

failure_modes: letting the noun stand alone in a title, a hashtag, an attribute field or a spoken answer
using a karat number without a coating qualifier
pricing or framing a plated piece as an investment or a generational heirloom
assuming a qualifier stated once at the top of a page covers everything below it
acceptance_tests: every occurrence of the noun on every controlled surface carries its qualifier, including truncated and mobile views
no imagery, price framing or copy positions the article as solid, investment-grade or a generational heirloom
the counter and message-reply script answers the direct question plainly and is known by whoever answers
revisit_triggers: a new channel introduces a title, attribute or truncation behaviour the wording has not been tested against
a reseller or affiliate publishes copy the shop did not write
a buyer question reveals a false impression the current wording allowed

base.update_signal: a buyer or channel interaction reveals a false solid-gold impression the current wording permitted

nodes.definition: Keep every statement about how the finish will hold up inside what the coating can physically do. Wear life is not a property of gold alone; it is set by coating thickness, deposit hardness, the underlayer stack, the wear location on the body and the wearer's chemistry and habits, which is why no honest single number exists and why any guarantee phrased in years is a promise the bench cannot keep. The defensible form is a qualitative band tied to the measured class and the wear exposure: a flash-class surface is a cosmetic finish that will show wear on contact areas quickly, a light decorative class suits earrings, pendants and occasional pieces, and only a heavy class belongs on rings and bracelets that take daily abrasion; published wear guidance of this shape exists as a handbook-class band, not as a warranty. Words like lifetime, permanent, never tarnishes, will not wear off and hypoallergenic are removed rather than softened. The band is paired with care instructions and with the honest statement that plating is renewable, since offering a re-plating service turns a limitation into a service relationship instead of a complaint.

included: the variables that make a single wear number dishonest
qualitative bands tied to measured class and wear location
the banned absolute vocabulary
care instructions and the renewable-coating framing as the honest completion of the band
excluded: testing wear and corrosion resistance, which belongs to the verification specialist
improving wear life by process change, which belongs to the bath chemistry and process specialists
individual health claims of any kind

pros.claim: A band tied to the measured class survives contact with reality, which is what stops the complaint stream
pros.example: a light-class pendant sold with a light-class expectation does not generate an angry message when a ring in the same order wears first

pros.claim: Offering re-plating converts an honest limitation into a repeat service instead of a refund
pros.example: a customer returns annually for a refresh rather than posting a wear-through photograph

cons.claim: Honest bands read as weaker than competitors' absolute promises and cost some sales at the moment of comparison
cons.example: a listing that says a finish will show wear on daily-worn rings sits beside one promising a lifetime finish

cons.claim: Bands are qualitative, so two staff can describe the same class differently unless the phrasing is fixed
cons.example: one person says months of regular wear and another says a season, and a buyer quotes the more generous one back

failure_modes: answering how long will it last with a number instead of a band and its conditions
using absolute vocabulary such as lifetime, permanent or never tarnishes
applying the same wear statement to a ring and to a pendant
letting a guarantee period in the terms of sale imply a wear-life promise the coating cannot meet
acceptance_tests: every wear statement names the measured class and the wear exposure it applies to
no controlled surface contains lifetime, permanent, never tarnishes, will not wear off or an unevidenced hypoallergenic phrase
care instructions and the re-plating option accompany every wear statement
staff answer the durability question in the same fixed phrasing
revisit_triggers: a run of complaints reports wear faster than the band implies
the thickness class or deposit hardness of a product changes
a warranty or returns term is introduced that touches wear

base.update_signal: complaint data shows real wear diverging from the advertised band, or a thickness or hardness change moves the class

nodes.definition: Decide what may be struck into the piece itself, which is the most permanent and least retractable claim surface a shop touches. Three distinctions carry the whole subject. A quality mark describes the coating class and is only permissible where the article meets that class; a fineness mark of the kind used on solid precious metal describes the material of the article and must never appear on a plated base-metal piece; and an assay or hallmarking regime, where one applies, is a legal system operated by an authority rather than a stamp a shop may imitate. Several jurisdictions additionally require that a quality mark be accompanied by a registered maker's mark or trademark that identifies who is responsible for it, which is a rule class to verify rather than an optional flourish. A mark cannot be recalled, cannot be edited on a later season's stock and travels with the piece into second-hand markets forever, so the working rule is that a mark is struck only when the dossier evidence is complete, the class is verified, and the marking regime of the market of sale has been read and recorded.

included: quality mark versus fineness mark versus authority hallmark
the maker or trademark identification requirement as a rule class to verify
the permanence of a mark as the reason for a stricter evidence bar
the decision not to mark as a legitimate and often correct option
excluded: stamping and laser-marking technique and tooling
national assay-office procedure, which is verified with that authority
packaging and tag design, which is the wording and disclosure territory

pros.claim: A stricter bar for permanent marks matches their permanence and keeps the shop out of the least fixable kind of error
pros.example: a run is tagged rather than stamped while an accredited thickness result is still pending

pros.claim: Understanding the maker-identification rule class prevents a well-meant quality mark from being non-compliant on its own
pros.example: a shop verifies whether its market requires a registered responsibility mark before striking any quality mark at all

cons.claim: Unmarked goods look less professional to trade buyers and invite the request to mark them anyway
cons.example: a boutique account asks for stamped stock to match the rest of its case

cons.claim: Marking regimes differ by market, so a single stamped stock item can be right in one destination and wrong in another
cons.example: stamped stock produced for the home market has to be held back from an export order

failure_modes: striking a fineness mark on a plated base-metal article
imitating the visual language of an authority hallmark
marking before the accredited evidence for the class exists
marking stock destined for a market whose marking regime was never read
acceptance_tests: every mark struck corresponds to a class the dossier evidences and to a rule class read for the destination
no mark on a plated article states a fineness of the article as though it were solid material
the maker or responsibility identification requirement is verified and recorded before any quality mark is used
revisit_triggers: a new destination with a different marking or hallmarking regime is opened
the class the product earns changes
a trade account requests marking of stock the shop does not normally mark

base.update_signal: a destination with a different marking regime is opened, or the class the product earns moves after stock has been marked

nodes.definition: Convert the earned term class and the evidence behind it into the finite set of sentences the shop is allowed to use, written out surface by surface, so that nobody has to compose a claim under time pressure. The set specifies the product name and the short title with the qualifier in its fixed position; the one-line description; the material statement that names the coating, the underlayer where it matters and the base metal; the durability band in fixed phrasing; the care line; the skin-contact statement where one is evidenced; the counter and message answers to the two questions buyers actually ask, which are whether it is real gold and how long it will last; and the phrases that are prohibited outright. Writing the prohibited list beside the permitted one is what makes the set usable, because the failure mode is not usually inventing a new claim but reaching for a familiar word. The set is versioned, dated and tied to the dossier that licenses it, and when the dossier changes the set is re-derived rather than patched.

included: permitted phrasing written per surface including titles, attributes and spoken answers
the prohibited-phrase list that sits beside it
versioning and dating tied to the licensing dossier
re-derivation rather than patching when evidence changes
excluded: brand voice, tone and campaign creative direction beyond the claim content
translation certification for export markets, which is verified separately
the legal opinion that the permitted set is lawful in a given market

pros.claim: A finite permitted set removes composition under pressure, which is when claims inflate
pros.example: an evening message from a buyer is answered by copying the approved answer instead of improvising a promise

pros.claim: Versioning ties every published sentence to the evidence state that licensed it
pros.example: a listing challenged months later is traced to the wording version and the dossier revision in force at the time

cons.claim: A rigid set feels stifling to whoever writes the marketing and gets quietly worked around
cons.example: a seasonal campaign adds a phrase the set does not contain because it sounded harmless

cons.claim: Maintaining per-surface phrasing multiplies with every new channel and language
cons.example: adding a second-language storefront doubles the set and introduces translation drift

failure_modes: publishing a sentence that is not in the set
patching one surface after an evidence change and leaving the others on the old wording
omitting the spoken and message answers so the counter contradicts the tag
letting a translation soften or strengthen a claim the source sentence controlled
acceptance_tests: every controlled surface for the product draws its claim sentences from the current wording version
the prohibited-phrase list exists and includes the absolute durability vocabulary and the unqualified noun
the wording version names the dossier revision that licenses it and its effective date
revisit_triggers: the dossier changes any evidence field or the earned class
a new surface, channel or language is added
a published sentence is found that the set does not contain

base.update_signal: the licensing dossier revision changes, or a published sentence is found outside the current permitted set

nodes.definition: Decide what travels to the buyer with the piece, on the principle that a disclosure made before the sale is information and the same disclosure made after a complaint is an excuse. The package states plainly that the article is plated and what it is plated onto; gives the wear band for that class and the wear locations that will show it first; gives care instructions that match the coating rather than generic jewellery advice, since abrasive polishing cloths and ultrasonic cleaning remove a thin gold layer; states the skin-contact position where one is evidenced and says nothing clinical where one is not; names the re-plating or refresh service and whether the shop offers it for this piece; and, for anything sold as a gift or keepsake, records the honest heirloom position, which is that a plated finish is renewable rather than permanent and that a piece intended to outlast a generation should be made in solid material. The package is a standing artifact attached to the product, not a paragraph someone remembers to mention, and the same content answers the counter question and the returns conversation.

included: the plated-and-onto-what statement
wear band, first-wear locations and coating-appropriate care
the evidenced skin-contact position and the silence where none exists
re-plating availability and the honest heirloom position
excluded: clinical advice, allergy management or any statement about an individual's health
returns, warranty and consumer-remedy law, which is verified as a rule class and handled by policy
gemstone, provenance and origin claims about non-plated elements of the piece

pros.claim: Pre-sale disclosure converts the predictable complaint into an expectation the buyer accepted
pros.example: a buyer whose ring shows wear at six months refers to the care card rather than to a refund policy

pros.claim: Coating-appropriate care instructions materially extend the life of the finish, which makes the disclosure a service rather than a disclaimer
pros.example: telling a buyer to keep the piece out of the ultrasonic cleaner prevents the fastest way to lose a thin gold layer

cons.claim: Disclosure at the point of sale reduces impulse conversion, and the cost is felt immediately while the benefit arrives later
cons.example: a gift buyer hesitates when told the finish is renewable rather than permanent

cons.claim: A package written once drifts out of step with the wording set unless the two are re-derived together
cons.example: the care card still describes a heavy class after the product dropped a rung

failure_modes: disclosing only in the returns policy where nobody reads it before buying
generic jewellery care advice that damages a thin coating
offering reassurance about skin reactions instead of the evidenced position and a referral
letting a keepsake or wedding sale proceed without the honest heirloom statement
acceptance_tests: the plated statement, wear band, care instructions and heirloom position are visible before purchase, not only after it
care instructions are specific to a thin gold coating and contradict no wording in the approved set
the skin-contact statement matches the evidence held and contains no clinical language
keepsake and wedding sales carry the renewable-finish statement in the record
revisit_triggers: the wording set or dossier changes the class or band
a complaint shows a buyer expectation the package did not set
a new skin-contact certificate or its absence changes what may be stated

base.update_signal: a complaint reveals an expectation the package failed to set, or the wording set changes the class or band

nodes.definition: Check the places the claim is actually published, because a correct wording set and a wrong page are the same failure to a buyer. Each channel imposes its own structure and each structure has a way of breaking a claim: marketplace titles truncate and the qualifier falls off the end, category and attribute fields offer a material value of gold with no plated option, imported product feeds and spreadsheet uploads carry old text, search-optimising titles stuff a karat number in for traffic, auto-generated variant names drop qualifiers, and a shop's own older listings sit unrevised for seasons. The review walks every live surface for the product against the current wording version, records what was checked and when, and treats the destinations a channel accepts orders from as the set of rule maps that bind that listing, which is why the most restrictive destination governs a listing that ships anywhere. Where a channel's structure makes a compliant claim impossible, the honest outcomes are to restrict the channel's shipping destinations or to not sell the product there.

included: structural claim breakage specific to each channel type
the dated walk of every live surface against the current wording version
binding a listing to the most restrictive destination it accepts
restricting or withdrawing where a channel cannot carry a compliant claim
excluded: search ranking, advertising spend and conversion optimisation
platform seller-policy disputes and appeals
imagery and price framing, which the implied-claim control handles

pros.claim: Reviewing the live surface catches breakage that the wording set alone cannot prevent
pros.example: a truncated mobile title is found dropping the qualifier that the desktop view shows

pros.claim: Binding a listing to its most restrictive destination resolves the multi-market question with one rule
pros.example: a storefront selling into three markets is worded for the strictest of the three rather than per order

cons.claim: The review is manual, repetitive and scales badly with catalogue size
cons.example: a hundred variants across three channels is a full day of checking per wording change

cons.claim: Wording for the most restrictive destination can read awkwardly or leave value on the table in permissive markets
cons.example: a market that would allow a shorter phrase gets the longer qualified one

failure_modes: checking the desktop page and never the truncated or mobile view
leaving attribute and category fields unreviewed because they are not prose
re-uploading an old feed file that reintroduces retired wording
reviewing new listings while old ones stay on superseded claims
acceptance_tests: every live surface for the product, including titles, attributes, variant names and feed sources, has been walked against the current wording version with a recorded date
each listing's shipping destinations are matched to rule-map entries and the wording follows the most restrictive of them
channels that cannot carry a compliant claim are restricted or the product is withdrawn from them
revisit_triggers: a wording version is issued
a channel changes its title, attribute or feed behaviour
shipping destinations are added to a channel
a bulk upload or feed sync runs

base.update_signal: a new wording version is issued, a channel changes its display or feed behaviour, or shipping destinations change

nodes.definition: Control the claims a listing makes without words, because a photograph, a price and a comparison speak louder than the material line beneath them. The recurring implied claims on a plating bench are visual and contextual: styling a plated piece among solid gold stock so the buyer reads the whole case as one material, using imagery of an assay stamp or a bullion motif, macro photography that hides the piece's scale and construction, an anchored price presented as a reduction from a solid-material level, urgency and scarcity framing that borrows investment language, category placement beside fine jewellery with no qualifier, and affiliate, influencer and reseller copy the shop briefs but does not write. The control is to review imagery and framing with the same checklist as the text, to include claim constraints in every creative and affiliate brief, and to treat the first non-compliant sentence a partner publishes as a brief failure rather than as their private mistake. Where an image cannot be made honest, it is not published, however good it looks.

included: visual and contextual routes to an unwritten claim
creative and affiliate briefs carrying the claim constraints
partner-published copy as the shop's own exposure
the decision not to publish an image that cannot be made honest
excluded: photographic technique, retouching and studio practice
advertising spend, placement bidding and campaign performance
the written claim sentences themselves, which the wording set governs

pros.claim: Reviewing imagery with the text catches the claim most buyers actually receive
pros.example: a hero shot styled beside solid stock is reshot before the campaign because it invited a material comparison

pros.claim: Putting constraints in the brief makes partner copy compliant before it is written rather than after it is reported
pros.example: an affiliate brief supplies the permitted sentences and the prohibited list alongside the images

cons.claim: Implied claims are judgement calls, so the review is slower and more contested than a text check
cons.example: two people disagree over whether a styled photograph reads as a solid-material claim

cons.claim: The most commercially effective imagery is often the most suggestive, so the control costs measurable performance
cons.example: the highest-converting lifestyle shot is the one that implies more than the coating can support

failure_modes: reviewing words while imagery and price framing go unchecked
briefing partners on look and tone but not on claim limits
letting scarcity or investment framing borrow value the product does not have
treating a reseller's non-compliant page as somebody else's problem
acceptance_tests: imagery and price framing for the product have been reviewed against the same claim checklist as the text, with the review dated
every creative, affiliate and reseller brief carries the permitted and prohibited phrase lists
no published image or framing positions the article as solid, investment-grade or generational
revisit_triggers: a new campaign, photograph set or partner is introduced
a partner publishes copy the shop did not supply
price positioning or promotional framing changes materially

base.update_signal: a partner publishes copy or imagery outside the brief, or a complaint traces a false impression to a picture rather than to a sentence

nodes.definition: Handle the request that arrives from the commercial side of the business rather than from a regulator: a boutique, a marketplace seller or a private-label account asking for wording the evidence does not support, usually attached to a purchase order and a deadline. The recurring shapes are a request to drop the coating qualifier for a cleaner title, to state a karat number the deposit has not been shown to hold, to use a term class the base metal cannot earn, to add a lifetime or hypoallergenic promise, to stamp goods the shop would only tag, or to supply unlabelled stock the account will describe in its own way. The move that works is refusal with a substitute: state the class the evidence supports, offer the wording that earns the account's marketing intent honestly, and offer the process change that would earn the requested class with its cost and lead time so the request becomes a commercial decision rather than a compliance argument. Every request and its outcome is recorded, and wording constraints belong in the supply agreement before the first shipment, because an account that has already sold the season is the worst moment to discover the disagreement.

included: the recurring shapes of non-compliant wording requests
refusal paired with a compliant substitute and a costed upgrade path
recording the request and its outcome
wording constraints written into the supply agreement in advance
excluded: the escalation and legal sign-off path itself, which is the escalation node
pricing negotiation and commercial terms beyond the claim constraint
policing what an account does on a platform the shop has no access to, beyond contract and reporting

pros.claim: Offering the costed upgrade converts a compliance refusal into a commercial choice the account can act on
pros.example: an account asking for a heavier-plate word is quoted the thicker specification with its price and lead time

pros.claim: Contractual wording constraints move the argument before the season instead of during it
pros.example: a private-label agreement specifies the permitted description set as an annex

cons.claim: Refusal can cost a significant account, and the loss is concrete while the avoided harm is hypothetical
cons.example: a wholesale order is lost to a supplier who will write the requested title

cons.claim: Unlabelled or private-label supply leaves the shop exposed to descriptions written downstream that it cannot see
cons.example: goods supplied plainly are listed by the account with a karat claim the shop never made

failure_modes: agreeing informally by email and leaving no record of the constraint
supplying unlabelled goods to an account with a known history of inflated descriptions
treating a large order as a reason to reinterpret the evidence
letting the account's copywriter negotiate directly with a staff member who has no claim authority
acceptance_tests: every non-compliant wording request is recorded with the substitute offered and the outcome
supply agreements for trade and private-label accounts contain the permitted description set and the prohibited phrases
requests reaching staff without claim authority are routed to the claim owner rather than answered
revisit_triggers: a new trade or private-label account is opened
an account is found publishing outside the agreed set
a repeat request signals that the standard offer does not meet the market's expectation

base.update_signal: an account publishes outside the agreed description set, or a repeat request pattern shows the standard offer is misaligned with the market

nodes.definition: Set the limits on what may be said about a piece the shop did not make, which is a daily situation for any bench that takes in repairs and refinishing. A customer's worn ring, an inherited chain, a market-bought vintage piece and a second-hand item bought to resell all arrive carrying marks, histories and assumptions the shop cannot verify. The working rules are that an existing mark is never re-cut, deepened, extended or repeated onto a re-plated surface, and is never allowed to imply that the new coating shares the marked material; that the shop describes only what it did, which is the coating it applied and the class that coating earns, and attributes everything else to the customer's account of the piece; that re-plating is recorded and disclosed in writing on the job record and, for anything the customer may resell, on a document that can travel with the piece, because an undisclosed re-plate misleads the next buyer and can obscure the wear that a valuer reads; and that a request to make a piece look like a higher material class than it is, or to plate over a hallmark so the article presents as something else, is refused and recorded.

included: never re-cutting, extending or implying an existing mark
describing only the work the shop performed
written disclosure of re-plating that can travel with the piece
refusing and recording requests to disguise a piece's material class
excluded: valuation, appraisal and authentication of the customer's piece
the plating and stripping process itself and its intake risk assessment, which belong to the process specialists
gemstone identification and provenance

pros.claim: Describing only the shop's own work is a defensible position for a piece whose history cannot be verified
pros.example: a job record states the coating applied and its class and attributes the piece's stated age to the customer

pros.claim: Written re-plate disclosure protects the next buyer and the shop at the same time
pros.example: a refinished vintage chain leaves with a document saying it was re-plated and when

cons.claim: Customers experience the refusal to refresh or re-cut a worn mark as pedantry and sometimes take the work elsewhere
cons.example: an owner wants a faint old stamp sharpened during refinishing and is told no

cons.claim: Disclosure paperwork on small repair jobs costs time that the job's price barely covers
cons.example: a low-value refinish carries the same record-keeping as a production batch

failure_modes: re-cutting or emphasising a mark during refinishing
repeating the customer's description of the piece as the shop's own statement
plating over a mark so the article presents as a different material class
returning a re-plated resale item with no record that it was re-plated
acceptance_tests: the job record separates what the customer said about the piece from what the shop verified and did
no existing mark on an incoming piece has been re-cut, extended or reproduced
re-plating is disclosed in writing on the record and on any document that travels with a resale piece
refused requests to disguise material class are recorded with the reason
revisit_triggers: a customer or trade account requests refinishing intended for resale
an incoming piece carries a mark the shop cannot interpret
a request arrives to plate over or obscure an existing mark

base.update_signal: a refinishing job is identified as destined for resale, or a request arrives to alter, obscure or re-cut an existing mark

nodes.definition: Build the record chain that lets the shop reconstruct, long after the parts have gone, why a specific piece carried the words it carried. Three linkages do the work. The first is batch identity: every released batch has a lot reference that appears on the internal record and, where practical, on the invoice or packing note, so a returned piece can be traced to a run.
