The second is evidence linkage: the lot points at the in-house screen results for that run, at the accredited certificates in force for that product state, at the dossier revision and wording version applied, and at the retained samples and witness coupons kept from the run. The third is time: everything is dated and nothing is overwritten, so a superseded claim remains readable as the claim that was true then. Retention is deliberate rather than accidental, set to cover the period in which a complaint, a marketplace challenge or an authority query can realistically arrive, and verified with the applicable rule class rather than guessed. The test of the trail is simple: hand a returned piece to the claim owner and see whether they can produce the evidence for its tag within an hour.

included: lot identity carried from the run to the customer record
linkage from lot to screens, certificates, dossier revision, wording version and retained samples
dating and non-overwriting so superseded claims stay readable
a deliberate retention period checked against the applicable rule class
excluded: production process logging itself, which belongs to the process specialists
accounting, tax and customs record obligations
personal data handling and privacy obligations for customer records

pros.claim: Lot linkage turns a vague complaint into a specific answerable question
pros.example: a worn ring returned nine months later is traced to the run whose screens showed the coating at the low end of its class

pros.claim: Retained samples give the shop a physical reference when a photograph and a memory disagree
pros.example: the retained piece from the same run is compared against the returned one to separate wear from a plating fault

cons.claim: Retention consumes storage, retained stock and attention for records that mostly are never called on
cons.example: a shelf of labelled sample bags and coupons accumulates across seasons

cons.claim: A trail is only as good as the weakest link, and lot marking is the link most often skipped on small orders
cons.example: a single-piece order ships with no lot reference and cannot be traced later

failure_modes: overwriting a claim record when the wording changes instead of versioning it
keeping certificates but not the screen results that show the batch resembled the certified article
retaining samples with no lot label
setting a retention period by habit without checking the rule class that governs it
acceptance_tests: a returned piece can be linked to a lot, and that lot to its screens, certificates, dossier revision and wording version
no record is overwritten; superseded versions remain readable with their dates
retained samples and coupons carry lot labels
the retention period is written down and traceable to a rule class that was verified with a date
revisit_triggers: a challenge cannot be answered from the trail
the retention rule class changes
a product state changes so the current linkage no longer describes what ships

base.update_signal: a challenge cannot be answered from the existing records, or a retention rule class is revised

nodes.definition: Recognise that a claim describes a process state, not a product name, and that a list of ordinary bench changes silently invalidates it. The change events that matter are a different gold chemistry or supplier, a change to the underlayer route or its thickness, a substrate or component substitution, a reduction in plating time or current to save gold, a racking or agitation change that moves where the coating is thinnest, a move from one deposit hardness to another, a new supplier of bought-in findings, and any change in the article's construction that alters what the buyer touches. The discipline is that a change proposal names the claims it may affect before it is made, that the affected products are marked provisional until re-measured, that accredited evidence is refreshed where the change touches a certified position such as skin-contact release, and that live listings and stock tags are corrected or the goods are held. The cost trap that makes this node necessary is specific and common: the saving from trimming a plating parameter is immediate and visible while the claim it invalidates is neither, so the change gets made and the words stay.

included: the enumerated change events that touch a claim
naming affected claims before the change is made
provisional status and re-measurement of affected products
correcting live listings and tagged stock or holding the goods
excluded: deciding whether the process change is technically sound, which belongs to the bath chemistry and process specialists
the economics of the change beyond its claim consequences
the measurement work itself

pros.claim: Naming affected claims before the change turns a silent invalidation into a scheduled task
pros.example: a proposal to trim plating time arrives with the list of listings that would drop a rung

pros.claim: Provisional status keeps goods sellable under a lower honest claim instead of stopping the shop
pros.example: stock is listed at the lower class while the re-measurement is arranged

cons.claim: Re-evidencing after every change is expensive enough to discourage improvements that would benefit the product
cons.example: a better underlayer route is postponed because it would require a fresh skin-contact certificate

cons.claim: Change events are easy to miss when they originate outside the plating room
cons.example: a findings supplier changes alloy without notice and no claim review is triggered

failure_modes: treating a chemistry or supplier substitution as equivalent because the finish looks the same
changing a parameter to save gold and leaving the wording untouched
re-measuring but forgetting the certified positions that also moved
correcting new listings while previously tagged stock still carries the old claim
acceptance_tests: every change event on the list triggers a recorded claim-impact assessment before implementation
affected products are marked provisional and re-measured before their previous claim is used again
certified positions touched by the change are refreshed or the affected market is closed
tagged stock and live listings are reconciled to the post-change claim
revisit_triggers: any listed change event occurs
a supplier notifies a reformulation or substitution
a screen result shows the process has drifted away from the certified state

base.update_signal: a change event occurs without a claim-impact assessment, or a supplier reformulation is discovered after the fact

nodes.definition: Handle what comes back, on the understanding that a complaint is both a customer matter and a claim-quality signal. The four recurring cases are wear-through faster than the buyer expected, tarnish or discolouration, a reported skin reaction, and a challenge to the description itself from a buyer, a marketplace or a competitor. The handling sequence is the same in each: identify the lot and pull the evidence trail, compare the piece against the retained sample to separate a plating fault from ordinary wear or from care that the coating cannot survive, answer with the recorded position rather than an improvised one, and apply the remedy the case warrants, which for a genuine fault is repair, re-plate or refund and for a met expectation is the re-plating service. Skin reactions are answered with the product facts held and a referral to professional care, with no clinical language and no reassurance the shop is not qualified to give. The part that most shops skip is the last: when the same complaint mode recurs across lots, the honest response is to change the claim rather than to keep paying remedies, because a band that keeps being wrong is a marketing error, not a run of unlucky customers.

included: the four recurring complaint modes and the common handling sequence
separating a plating fault from ordinary wear using retained samples
referral rather than clinical response for reported reactions
treating a recurring complaint mode as a claim-correction signal
excluded: consumer-remedy law, statutory guarantee periods and refund obligations, which are verified as a rule class and set by policy
any diagnosis, treatment advice or reassurance about a health effect
the plating rework itself and its process decisions

pros.claim: Answering from the evidence trail turns a dispute into a factual conversation
pros.example: a challenge to a description is answered with the lot, the measurement and the date rather than with an apology

pros.claim: Reading recurrence as a claim signal fixes the cause instead of paying for it repeatedly
pros.example: three wear complaints on the same style move that style down a durability band and into a heavier specification

cons.claim: Investigating properly costs more than refunding immediately, so the learning is easy to trade away
cons.example: a quick refund closes the case and the pattern behind it stays invisible

cons.claim: A remedy given in goodwill can be read by the customer as an admission that the original claim was false
cons.example: a courtesy re-plate is quoted back as proof the wear statement was untrue

failure_modes: settling every case without recording the mode, the lot and the cause
offering a clinical opinion or reassurance about a reported reaction
blaming the customer's care without comparing against a retained sample
treating repeated complaints of one mode as isolated customer-service events
acceptance_tests: each complaint records the mode, the lot, the comparison against the retained sample and the outcome
reaction reports are answered with held product facts plus a referral, with the interaction recorded and no clinical statement made
a recurrence threshold exists and, when crossed, produces a claim or specification change rather than another remedy
revisit_triggers: the same complaint mode appears across more than one lot
a marketplace or authority challenges a description
a remedy pattern shows the durability band is systematically optimistic

base.update_signal: a complaint mode recurs across lots, or a challenge cannot be answered from the recorded position

nodes.definition: Define what happens the moment a claim question exceeds what the bench may decide, so that the answer is a procedure rather than a mood. The triggers are specific: a request to use a term the evidence does not support that is not withdrawn when the substitute is offered; a rule text whose application to the shop's product is genuinely unclear; a market entry where the skin-contact or marking position cannot be evidenced; a challenge from a marketplace, an authority or a competitor; a discovery that goods already sold carried a claim the evidence does not support; and any question that touches another party's marks or rights. The path is fixed: freeze the affected wording and hold the affected release, record the question, the product, the evidence held and the date, produce the compliant fallback wording so the business is not stopped where an honest lower claim exists, and route the decision to a human with competence in the selling jurisdiction. Two rules make it work in a small shop: the freeze is applied by the claim owner without needing agreement from the account or the campaign, and the escalation is closed in writing, with the answer and its date fed back into the jurisdiction register so the same question is not re-litigated next season.

included: the enumerated escalation triggers
freeze, record, fallback wording and route-to-human as one fixed path
the claim owner's unilateral freeze authority
written closure fed back into the jurisdiction register
excluded: providing the legal answer, which is exactly what is being escalated
safety and waste emergencies, which follow their own escalation routes in the sibling knowledge bases
commercial negotiation with the account, which continues separately from the compliance question

pros.claim: A fixed path removes the hesitation that makes small shops guess at legal questions under deadline
pros.example: an unclear export marking question freezes one listing rather than stalling the whole shipment

pros.claim: Feeding the closed answer back into the register converts one paid legal question into standing shop knowledge
pros.example: counsel's answer on a term's use in an export market becomes a dated register entry

cons.claim: Escalation costs money and time that a small bench feels immediately, which biases the shop toward deciding for itself
cons.example: a single clarification consumes the margin of the order that raised it

cons.claim: Over-escalation trains the business to route routine questions outward and slows everything down
cons.example: a question already answered by an existing register entry is sent out again

failure_modes: answering a legal question at the bench because the deadline is close
freezing the wording but letting the affected stock ship anyway
closing an escalation verbally so nothing is recorded
never feeding the answer back, so the same question recurs each season
acceptance_tests: each escalation record names the trigger, the product, the evidence held, the fallback wording used and the date
affected releases are held while the escalation is open, not merely flagged
closures are written, dated and reflected in the jurisdiction register
the claim owner's freeze authority has been exercised without requiring commercial agreement
revisit_triggers: a trigger fires that the current list does not describe
an escalation closes with an answer that contradicts an existing register entry
a frozen claim stays frozen long enough to affect the product's viability

base.update_signal: a trigger fires that the list does not cover, or a closed escalation contradicts an existing register entry

nodes.definition: Hold the single pass condition that stands between a finished batch and the market, and hold it as a conjunction rather than as a score. The batch is released only when the dossier for the product is complete with dated evidence in every field or an explicit unknown that closes the affected market; the earned term class follows from the substrate, worst-case thickness and fineness evidence rather than from intention; the skin-contact position is evidenced or the restricted market is closed; the wording version in force is applied on every controlled surface and the live channel walk is recorded; imagery and price framing have been reviewed; the disclosure package is present before purchase; lot linkage and retained samples exist for the run; and no escalation is open against the product. A partial pass is a fail, because the value of the gate is precisely that it cannot be met by nine strong answers and one hopeful one. The gate is also the natural place to state the standing precedence of this whole subdomain: compliance and honesty outrank the ship date, the campaign and the account, in that order, every time they meet.

included: the conjunctive pass condition and its explicit clauses
partial pass counted as fail
the standing precedence of compliance over schedule and campaign
the recorded release decision with its date and owner
excluded: the safety readiness and waste-handling gates that govern the same batch inside the shop, which belong to the sibling knowledge bases and are not weakened by this one
quality acceptance for appearance and adhesion, which is the verification specialist's gate
commercial approval of price and margin

pros.claim: A conjunctive gate is auditable and cannot be argued down clause by clause
pros.example: a release is refused because lot labelling is missing even though every other clause passes

pros.claim: Stating precedence once at the gate settles the recurring argument in advance
pros.example: a launch deadline does not reopen the question of whether the claim can ship unevidenced

cons.claim: A hard gate at the end of the flow concentrates delay at the worst possible moment
cons.example: a missing certificate stops a season's stock on the day it was due to ship

cons.claim: A gate with many clauses invites a checkbox ritual that stops testing anything real
cons.example: clauses are ticked from memory during a rush rather than checked against the records

failure_modes: releasing on a partial pass with a promise to complete the evidence afterwards
checking the gate for the first shipment of a product and never for the reorders
ticking clauses without opening the underlying records
letting a campaign date or an account's deadline substitute for a clause
acceptance_tests: the release record for the batch shows every clause with the record it was checked against, dated and signed by the claim owner
no batch has been released with an open escalation or an unfilled evidence field
reorders and repeat runs pass the gate again rather than inheriting the first run's decision
revisit_triggers: a batch is found in the market that did not pass the gate
a clause is repeatedly satisfied by memory rather than by a record
a new product type introduces a claim condition the clause list does not cover

base.update_signal: a released batch is found not to have met a clause, or a new product type raises a claim condition the clause list does not cover

edges.why_related: the mandate says every word is a regulated claim, which only becomes actionable once the shop knows whose rules govern the markets it actually sells into
edges.benefit_of_coupling: the stop authority is exercised against a named rule class instead of a feeling

edges.why_related: the ladder is only usable once the rule text of the selling market has been read and dated, because the class boundaries and their conditions are set there
the base-metal check exists because specific rungs of the ladder are gated by what lies under the gold
the ladder turns thickness into the number a word depends on, which is what makes the location, representativeness and provenance of that number matter
the dossier cannot conclude a term class without a recorded fineness position and its source
whether a skin-contact release restriction applies at all, and in what scope, is a property of the market of sale recorded in the register
deciding what a thickness number must be forces the question of which grade of measurement is allowed to produce it
the dossier's earned class rests on the recorded worst-case thickness with its provenance
the skin-contact position, whether certified or explicitly closed, is one of the dossier fields that decides where the product may be offered
the permitted sentences are derived from the dossier's earned class and evidence, and are versioned against the dossier revision that licensed them
the qualifier rule fixes the shape of every permitted sentence and populates the prohibited list beside it
the review has nothing to check live surfaces against until a dated wording version exists
the imagery and framing review runs on the same surfaces the text review walks, and inherits the destination binding it established
the trail links lots to the dossier revision and wording version in force, so the dossier must exist and be versioned before a lot can point at it
the gate's lot-linkage and retained-sample clauses are satisfied by the trail, and a release decision without them cannot be reconstructed later
a request that survives the refusal-with-substitute move is exactly the trigger the escalation path is built for
the substrate closes off whole families of permitted sentences no matter what the coating measures
edges.risk_of_conflict: marketing pressure to use a term the base metal can never earn
edges.example: a steel-cored piece cannot carry the vermeil sentence at any plating thickness

edges.why_related: the evidence grade held sets the ceiling on which sentences may be published rather than merely used internally
edges.example: an in-house screen supports an internal decision to proceed but not a printed marking word

edges.why_related: for skin-contact goods the gate cannot pass on wording alone; the market-access position must be evidenced or that market closed
no mark expressing a purity or karat position may be struck without recorded fineness evidence for the deposit
the line applies to impressions created by imagery, placement and price exactly as it applies to sentences
edges.example: styling plated stock among solid pieces makes the same claim the prohibited sentence would

edges.why_related: the destinations a channel accepts orders from determine which register entries bind the listing, and the most restrictive of them governs
the measured class caps the wear band that may be advertised, since wear life cannot be promised beyond what the coating physically carries
an account's wording and deadline collide with a gate that will not pass on a partial evidence set
edges.resolution_rule: the gate wins without exception: the batch ships under the wording its evidence supports or does not ship, the account is offered the compliant substitute and the costed upgrade path, and the refusal and its reason are recorded

edges.why_related: campaign framing wants the most flattering impression while the disclosure exists to set an accurate expectation before purchase
edges.resolution_rule: disclosure wins at the point of sale: the plated statement, wear band and care position stay visible before purchase, and any imagery that only works when the disclosure is hidden is reshot or dropped

edges.why_related: the worst-case reading regularly lands below the class the wording, pricing and photography of a product already assume
edges.resolution_rule: the measurement governs: the wording drops to the class the worst-case number supports, or the process is changed and the batch re-measured before the higher wording is used again

edges.why_related: a cost-saving process change is immediate while the wording it invalidates is already live across channels and printed on stock
edges.resolution_rule: the change does not take effect for saleable goods until affected claims are reassessed: mark affected products provisional, re-measure, re-derive the wording version, and correct tagged stock and live listings before the post-change goods are sold under the old words

edges.why_related: a customer refinishing a marked piece wants the worn mark restored, which would be the shop applying a mark to a surface it did not earn
edges.resolution_rule: the marking discipline wins: no existing mark is re-cut, deepened or reproduced during refinishing, the customer is told why in writing, and the re-plating is disclosed on the record instead

edges.why_related: remedying each wear complaint individually is cheaper this month than admitting the advertised band is systematically optimistic
edges.resolution_rule: once the recurrence threshold for one wear mode is crossed, the claim is corrected rather than remedied again: the band moves down or the specification moves up, and the wording set and disclosure are reissued

edges.why_related: a thin or porous gold layer over a nickel underlayer is the physical route by which nickel reaches skin, which is why the coated-article route ages the piece before measuring release
private-label and reseller arrangements move the copy and imagery to people the shop does not supervise, which is where unwritten claims appear
the expectation set before purchase determines both how many wear complaints arrive and what the shop can point to when one does
each change event creates a new product state that must appear in the trail as a dated boundary between what earlier and later lots may claim
the substrate question is settled first because a piece whose base metal rules out the intended class need not be measured for it at all
the dated channel walk is one of the clauses the gate checks, so it is performed before the release decision rather than after publication
what comes back from the market is evidence about the product state and belongs in the dossier's change history alongside the measurements
the written closure of an escalation is exactly the kind of dated, sourced answer the register exists to hold, which stops the question recurring each season
a gate refusal is the strongest signal that the permitted set is out of step with the evidence, and it feeds the next wording version

both apply the same earned class to a surface the buyer will read, one struck permanently into metal and one published and revisable, and both fail in the same way when the class moves and the surface does not

conflict_axes.name: claim_strength_vs_evidence_grade
conflict_axes.description: The strongest word the product might plausibly deserve pulls against the word its held evidence can actually defend, and the gap is widest exactly when an in-house screen agrees with the hoped-for class and no accredited result exists yet.
poles: publish only what the evidence grade carries
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the evidence sets the ceiling: publish the class the held grade supports, keep the stronger word as a costed upgrade with its testing lead time, and never let a screen result stand in for a certificate

conflict_axes.name: ship_date_vs_claim_gate
conflict_axes.description: Seasonal deadlines, market dates and account promises all arrive at the same moment as the release decision, and the gate is the last thing standing between finished stock and revenue.
poles: hold until every gate clause is met
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: compliance and honesty outrank the schedule: ship the stock under the lower honest claim if one exists, otherwise hold, and treat the delay as the cost of the process change that created it

conflict_axes.name: conversion_pressure_vs_disclosure_completeness
conflict_axes.description: Everything that makes an expectation accurate before purchase, from the plated statement to the wear band and the renewable-finish position, also slows the buyer down at the moment they were ready to buy.
poles: set an accurate expectation before purchase
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: disclosure stays before the purchase and is written as service rather than as disclaimer; the conversion cost is accepted and recovered through re-plating and repeat custom instead of through vagueness

conflict_axes.name: gold_cost_vs_ladder_position
conflict_axes.description: Every rung of the marking ladder is bought with deposited gold and plating time, so the cheapest viable coating and the most valuable word are pulling in opposite directions on the same batch.
poles: reach the class the marketing depends on
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: decide the class before quoting the piece, specify the process to it, and if the cost forces a lower class then move the words down with it rather than keeping the words and thinning the coating

conflict_axes.name: average_reading_vs_worst_case_point
conflict_axes.description: The convenient measurement on a flat exposed face flatters the batch while the recess or ring interior that decides the claim and the customer's experience reads lower.
poles: judge at the thinnest claim-relevant point
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the worst-case point governs any thickness-dependent word; a near-boundary reading is resolved downward or re-measured by a better method rather than rounded up

conflict_axes.name: account_revenue_vs_wording_refusal
conflict_axes.description: The account asking for the non-compliant sentence is often the one whose order fills the month, and the harm avoided by refusing is invisible while the lost order is not.
poles: keep the account by accommodating its wording
hold the wording line and risk the account
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: refuse the wording and keep the account if possible: offer the compliant substitute, the costed specification upgrade and a written description annex, and record the request and outcome either way

conflict_axes.name: one_global_copy_vs_per_market_wording
conflict_axes.description: A single description is cheap to maintain and consistent for the brand, while the markets a channel ships to can define the same words differently and impose different skin-contact and marking obligations.
poles: word each market to its own rule map
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: bind each listing to the most restrictive destination it accepts orders from, or restrict the destinations; per-market wording is only worth its maintenance cost where the volume justifies a separate storefront

conflict_axes.name: customer_goodwill_remedy_vs_claim_correction
conflict_axes.description: Settling each complaint quickly protects the relationship and the rating, while the pattern of complaints is the cheapest available evidence that a published claim is wrong.
poles: remedy the individual case and move on
correct the claim that produced the case
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: do both but never only the first: record mode, lot and cause on every case, and once the recurrence threshold is crossed change the band or the specification rather than continuing to pay

conflict_axes.name: permanent_mark_vs_revisable_label
conflict_axes.description: A struck mark signals confidence and satisfies trade buyers, but it cannot be recalled when the class moves, while a tag or listing can be corrected the same afternoon.
poles: mark the metal for permanence and trade credibility
keep the claim on revisable surfaces
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: mark only where evidence is complete, accredited and stable across the destinations the stock will reach; while any of that is provisional, carry the claim on the tag and the listing instead

edge_cases.description: A steel-cored wire ring is plated to a genuinely heavy gold thickness and the shop wants to call it vermeil because the coating exceeds the class boundary
edge_cases.trigger: a thickness achievement is mistaken for satisfying the whole term class
edge_cases.mitigation: apply the base-metal condition first: the vermeil class requires a sterling silver base, so the honest word is the heavy electroplate class the evidence supports and the marketing copy is rewritten around it

edge_cases.description: A marketplace listing's material attribute offers only gold as a value and the auto-generated mobile title truncates the coating qualifier off the end
edge_cases.trigger: a channel's structure removes or contradicts the qualifier the wording set requires
edge_cases.mitigation: move the qualifier adjacent to the noun at the start of the title, choose the plated attribute value where one exists, and where the structure cannot carry a compliant claim restrict or withdraw the listing rather than accept the breakage

edge_cases.description: A handheld thickness reading taken on the curved face of thin plated wire returns a number just above the class boundary
edge_cases.trigger: geometry and thin-coating effects push an instrument reading across a boundary that decides a word
edge_cases.mitigation: treat a near-boundary reading on unfavourable geometry as unresolved: measure a flat witness coupon plated alongside the run or commission an accredited measurement, and word the batch at the lower class until the better number exists

edge_cases.description: A customer says they react to jewellery and asks whether these earrings are safe for them
edge_cases.trigger: a health question arrives at the counter attached to a product decision
edge_cases.mitigation: state only the held facts, which are the metal stack, whether a nickel underlayer is present and whether a skin-contact release certificate exists for that stack, offer the nickel-free route if the shop has one, refer the person to a physician for anything about their own reaction, and record the interaction without any clinical statement

edge_cases.description: The shop is asked to plate spoons and cup rims for a homeware line and to describe them as food-safe gold
edge_cases.trigger: a plated article moves into a use class the jewellery evidence set does not cover
edge_cases.mitigation: record the food-contact rule class as unverified, make no food-contact claim, and hold the line until that rule class is read in the market of sale and the appropriate evidence obtained; a jewellery-grade nickel underlayer with a hardened gold surface is not presumed suitable for food contact

edge_cases.description: The gold solution supplier is changed mid-season and the finish looks identical, so production continues under the existing listings
edge_cases.trigger: a chemistry substitution that leaves appearance unchanged
edge_cases.mitigation: run the claim-impact assessment before the first production batch: the deposit's fineness position comes from the new product's technical data sheet or a fresh assay, affected products are provisional until re-measured, and certified positions touched by the change are refreshed

edge_cases.description: A vintage chain stamped with a fineness mark is brought in for re-plating and the owner intends to resell it as restored
edge_cases.trigger: refinishing work on a marked piece destined for resale
edge_cases.mitigation: leave the existing mark untouched, describe only the coating the shop applied and its class, issue a written record that the piece was re-plated and when so it can travel to the next buyer, and refuse any request to sharpen, extend or add a mark

edge_cases.description: An affiliate posts that the shop's pieces are solid gold at an unbeatable price, using images the shop supplied
edge_cases.trigger: copy published by a partner outside the brief
edge_cases.mitigation: treat it as the shop's exposure: request immediate correction, reissue the brief with the permitted and prohibited lists, record the incident, and suspend the arrangement if the copy is not corrected

edge_cases.description: The sample sent for accredited testing was hand-finished and plated on a light rack, while production runs full racks
edge_cases.trigger: an unrepresentative article is used to anchor a claim
edge_cases.mitigation: draw test articles from a normal production lot and record the lot on the submission, and where a favourable sample has already anchored a claim, re-test from production and correct the wording if the result moves

edge_cases.description: A ring sold under a light decorative class comes back worn through at the shank inside three months
edge_cases.trigger: real wear contradicts the advertised band for a specific style
edge_cases.mitigation: trace the lot, compare against the retained sample to separate a plating fault from expected wear, remedy the individual case, and if the mode recurs move rings to a heavier specification or stop selling that style as a ring rather than repeating the remedy

edge_cases.description: A marking rule in an export destination is revised while tagged stock and printed cards for that market are already in the building
edge_cases.trigger: a rule change lands after stock has been claim-labelled
edge_cases.mitigation: freeze the affected destination, re-read and re-date the register entry, re-derive the wording version, re-tag or re-card the stock or divert it to a destination it still satisfies, and escalate if the correct reading of the new text is unclear

edge_cases.description: A trade buyer asks for goods described as gold filled because that is what their catalogue category is called
edge_cases.trigger: a request for a term class that no plating process can produce
edge_cases.mitigation: explain that the clad classes describe mechanically bonded mill stock and cannot be produced by deposition, offer the heaviest electroplate class the shop can evidence with its cost, and if the buyer insists, decline the order and record the refusal

workflow.action: Declare claim review a release gate and name its owner
workflow.description: Inventory every claim surface the product will carry and name the person who may hold a shipment on a claim question
workflow.artifact: claim policy note listing the claim surfaces and the named claim owner
workflow.gate: the surface inventory covers tag, stamp, invoice, listing text, attribute fields, imagery, care card and wholesale sheet, and the owner's stop authority is stated

workflow.action: Register the selling jurisdictions and their rule classes
workflow.description: List the destinations the enabled channels accept orders from and record the marking, advertising, skin-contact and consumer rule classes for each with the document consulted and the date
workflow.gate: every open destination has an entry naming its authority, source document, read date and re-read date, and unverified destinations are closed rather than assumed permissive

workflow.action: Position the product on the marking-term ladder as a hypothesis
workflow.description: State the rung the product is intended to reach and the three conditions that rung requires in the market of sale
workflow.artifact: intended term class with its conditions written out
workflow.gate: the intended rung names its base-metal, thickness and fineness conditions and cites the register entry they were read from

workflow.action: Confirm the substrate and underlayer stack before any gold is spent
workflow.description: Record what the piece is made of and what lies under the gold, and strike out every term class the substrate cannot earn
workflow.artifact: recorded substrate and underlayer stack on the job record
workflow.gate: the stack is recorded with its evidence and any substrate-gated class the piece cannot earn is explicitly ruled out

workflow.action: Measure thickness at the worst-case point of the claim area
workflow.description: Take the claim-relevant reading at the thinnest location on a piece representative of the production run and record its provenance
workflow.artifact: thickness record with location, method, instrument, operator, date and lot
workflow.gate: the reading is from the worst-case location on a production-representative article and any near-boundary result has been resolved downward or re-measured

workflow.description: Record the fineness the deposit is verified to hold, from the technical data sheet of the chemistry in use or from an assay on an adequate witness
workflow.artifact: fineness position with its source and date
workflow.gate: the fineness position names its source, satisfies the fineness condition of the intended rung, and no colour description is being used as a purity claim

workflow.description: For skin-contact articles, either commission accredited release evidence for the stack, specify a nickel-free underlayer route, or close the restricted market
workflow.artifact: skin-contact position with certificate reference or a recorded decision not to offer
workflow.gate: every restricted market the product is offered into has evidence for the current stack or is closed, and no unevidenced hypoallergenic or nickel-free phrasing exists anywhere

workflow.action: Assemble the product claim dossier and conclude the earned class
workflow.description: Bring substrate, thickness, fineness, certificates and dates into one record and conclude the term class the evidence actually earns
workflow.artifact: versioned product claim dossier with an effective date
workflow.gate: every field is filled with dated evidence or marked unknown, and the concluded class follows from the recorded evidence rather than from the intended rung

workflow.action: Derive the approved wording set for every surface
workflow.description: Write the permitted sentences for title, description, material statement, durability band, care line, skin-contact statement and spoken answers, plus the prohibited list
workflow.artifact: dated wording version tied to the dossier revision
workflow.gate: each permitted sentence traces to a dossier field, the qualifier travels with the noun in every position, and the prohibited list includes the absolute durability vocabulary

workflow.description: Assemble the plated statement, wear band, coating-appropriate care instructions, re-plating offer and honest heirloom position that travel with the piece
workflow.artifact: care card and pre-purchase disclosure content
workflow.gate: the disclosure is visible before purchase, its care advice suits a thin coating, and its content contradicts nothing in the wording version

workflow.action: Walk every live channel surface against the wording version
workflow.description: Check titles, truncated views, attribute fields, variant names, feed sources and imagery on every channel, and bind each listing to its most restrictive destination
workflow.artifact: dated channel review record listing every surface checked
workflow.gate: every live surface matches the current wording version, destinations are matched to register entries, and channels that cannot carry a compliant claim are restricted or withdrawn

workflow.action: Run the release gate and record the decision
workflow.description: Check every clause against its underlying record, then release or hold the batch and record the decision with its date and owner
workflow.artifact: signed release record naming each clause and the record it was checked against
workflow.gate: all clauses pass against opened records, no escalation is open against the product, lot linkage and retained samples exist, and a partial pass is recorded as a hold

dominance_rules.rule: The claim release gate dominates the ship date, the campaign date and the account deadline
dominance_rules.rationale: an unevidenced claim that reaches a buyer cannot be recalled, while a delayed shipment can be explained, discounted or re-planned
dominance_rules.trigger: a batch is due to ship or publish and any gate clause is unmet
dominance_rules.action: release under the lower honest claim if the evidence supports one, otherwise hold the batch, tell the account the reason and record the decision

dominance_rules.rule: The base-metal condition dominates any thickness achievement
dominance_rules.rationale: substrate-gated term classes are defined by what lies under the gold, so no deposit thickness can earn a class the base metal excludes
dominance_rules.trigger: a term class with a base-metal condition is proposed for a piece with a different substrate
dominance_rules.action: strike the class out and word the product at the highest class its substrate and coating together support

dominance_rules.rule: Accredited evidence dominates in-house screening wherever a published claim is at stake
dominance_rules.rationale: screens are comparative process-control tools and cannot anchor a marking, fineness or market-access position
dominance_rules.trigger: a screen result is offered as the basis for a printed or published claim
dominance_rules.action: hold the claim at the level the accredited evidence supports and commission the send-out test if the higher claim matters commercially

dominance_rules.rule: The worst-case point dominates the average and the convenient reading
dominance_rules.rationale: a marking class is judged at the thinnest claim-relevant location, which is also where the buyer's wear will appear first
dominance_rules.trigger: thickness readings differ across the piece or a boundary decision rests on which location was measured
dominance_rules.action: use the worst-case reading, and resolve any near-boundary result downward or by a better measurement

dominance_rules.rule: The never-solid-gold line dominates every customer, account, channel and campaign request
dominance_rules.rationale: the false impression that a plated article is solid material is the single most damaging claim a plating bench can allow, and it is created by omission as easily as by assertion
dominance_rules.trigger: any request or structure that drops the qualifier, adds an unqualified karat number, or frames the article as solid, investment-grade or generational
dominance_rules.action: refuse, restore the qualifier in every position, offer the compliant substitute, and record the request and the refusal

dominance_rules.rule: The skin-contact compliance position dominates market entry for skin-contact goods
dominance_rules.rationale: market access for a restricted article is a precondition of selling it there, not a matter to settle after the first complaint
dominance_rules.trigger: a skin-contact product is proposed for a market with a release restriction and no evidence exists for the current stack
dominance_rules.action: close that market for the product until certified, or specify the nickel-free route, and never substitute reassuring language for evidence

dominance_rules.rule: The most restrictive destination a listing accepts dominates its wording
dominance_rules.rationale: a listing that ships anywhere is bound by every rule map it can reach, and one description cannot be right in one market and wrong in another
dominance_rules.trigger: a channel accepts orders from destinations whose rule classes differ
dominance_rules.action: word the listing for the most restrictive destination or restrict the destinations the listing accepts

dominance_rules.rule: A documented refusal with a compliant substitute dominates informal accommodation of a trade account
dominance_rules.rationale: an unrecorded verbal accommodation becomes the account's evidence that the shop approved the wording
dominance_rules.trigger: an account requests wording the evidence does not support
dominance_rules.action: issue the substitute wording and the costed upgrade path in writing, record the request and outcome, and escalate if the request is not withdrawn

dominance_rules.rationale: an expectation set before the sale is information while the same words after a complaint are an excuse, and the shop's remedy exposure follows directly from which one it chose
dominance_rules.trigger: a page, image or checkout flow would perform better with the plated statement, wear band or care position removed or demoted
dominance_rules.action: keep the disclosure visible before purchase and recover the conversion cost through the re-plating service and repeat custom

dominance_rules.rule: A recurring complaint mode dominates the advertised durability band
dominance_rules.rationale: repeated real-world failure of one mode is stronger evidence about the product than the band that was written before it shipped
dominance_rules.trigger: the same wear or tarnish mode recurs across lots beyond the shop's recurrence threshold
dominance_rules.action: move the band down or the specification up, reissue the wording version and disclosure, and stop selling the style into the wear class it cannot survive

dominance_rules.rule: Permanence dominates convenience when deciding to strike a mark
dominance_rules.rationale: a struck mark cannot be corrected, recalled or re-issued and travels with the piece into second-hand markets indefinitely
dominance_rules.trigger: a mark is proposed while any evidence is provisional or any destination's marking regime is unread
dominance_rules.action: carry the claim on the tag and listing instead, and strike the mark only once the evidence is complete and the regime has been read and recorded

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the substrate and underlayer stack before quoting, plating or writing any copy
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a whole product concept, price and photograph set built on a term class the base metal can never earn

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the destination rule classes before the first listing is written, not after the first export order
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rewriting every listing, tag and card once the shop discovers which markets its channels actually sell into

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the thickness and fineness specification the product will be built to before pricing it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the trap of discovering the quoted price only supports a thinner coating after the wording and photography assume the heavier class

anti_rework_rules.rule: Take the claim-relevant measurement at the worst-case point before choosing the ladder word
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-tagging, re-carding and re-listing an entire run when the recess reading finally gets taken

anti_rework_rules.rule: Commission accredited testing from a production-representative article once the process is frozen
anti_rework_rules.prevents: paying for a certificate that describes a hand-finished sample or a process state the shop has already left

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the durability band, care text and disclosure in the same pass as the marking word
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a compliant tag sitting beside an overstated advertisement and a care card that contradicts both

anti_rework_rules.rule: Put the approved wording set into channel templates, creative briefs and affiliate packs before any photography or campaign work begins
anti_rework_rules.prevents: recalling imagery, reshooting a campaign and chasing partner posts that were briefed on a claim the product cannot make

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record lot identity, screen results and retained samples on the day the batch is released
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unanswerable challenge months later, when the run is gone and nobody can prove what the tag rested on

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the claim-impact assessment before implementing any chemistry, thickness, substrate or supplier change
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a season of goods sold under words the new process state no longer supports, and the recall of tagged stock that follows

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the permitted description set into the trade or private-label agreement before the first shipment
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unwinnable mid-season argument with an account that has already printed its catalogue

iteration_protocol.trigger: a register entry passes its re-read date or an authority publishes a change to a marking, advertising or skin-contact rule
iteration_protocol.action: re-read and re-date the entry, re-derive the wording version for affected products, and hold releases into that destination until the review closes

iteration_protocol.trigger: any chemistry, thickness, underlayer, substrate, racking or component-supplier change is proposed or discovered
iteration_protocol.action: run the claim-impact assessment, mark affected products provisional, re-measure and refresh certified positions before the previous claim is used again

iteration_protocol.trigger: a claim-relevant measurement lands below or within uncertainty of the class the current wording assumes
iteration_protocol.action: step the wording down to the supported class for the affected lots before they ship, and decide separately whether to change the process to regain the higher class

iteration_protocol.trigger: a trade account, reseller or customer requests a claim the evidence does not support and does not accept the substitute
iteration_protocol.action: freeze the affected wording, produce the fallback, record the request, and route the decision to a human with competence in the selling jurisdiction

iteration_protocol.trigger: the same wear, tarnish or reaction complaint mode recurs across more than one lot
iteration_protocol.action: correct the claim rather than the case: move the durability band or the specification, reissue the wording version and the disclosure package, and record the change in the dossier history

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new channel, marketplace, language or shipping destination is enabled
iteration_protocol.action: extend the register, re-bind affected listings to their most restrictive destination, and walk the new surfaces including imagery and briefs before the first order is accepted

iteration_protocol.trigger: an accredited certificate reaches the shop's refresh point or the tested article stops representing production
iteration_protocol.action: re-test from a production lot, update the dossier and the trail, and close the affected market if the position cannot be re-evidenced

iteration_protocol.trigger: a challenge from a buyer, a marketplace or an authority cannot be answered from the existing records
iteration_protocol.action: reconstruct what is recoverable, record the gap, repair the trail for current products, and treat the gap as a gate clause failure until it is closed

priority_rationale: The frame comes first because nothing downstream is decidable until claim review is a gate with an owner and until the shop knows which markets' rule classes bind its words; the term-class ladder and the base-metal condition follow because they define what could be claimed at all; thickness, fineness and the skin-contact position come next because they are the evidence that decides which rung is actually earned, and the accredited-versus-in-house separation governs whether that evidence can carry a published claim; the dossier consolidates evidence into one auditable conclusion, from which the approved wording, the disclosure package and the permanent-mark decision are derived rather than invented; channel review and implied-claim control apply those words to the surfaces buyers actually read; trade-account pressure, replating limits, the evidence trail, process-change reclassification and complaint handling are the forces that erode a correct claim over time; and the release gate is last because it is the conjunction of everything above it and the single point where compliance and honesty are allowed to outrank the schedule.
